name: SimpleX Chat
author: bakugo
description: One-click SimpleX Chat access: a bar chip that launches the app and toggles its window to a hidden Hyprland workspace, keeping it one click away and running in the background like a tray app.

barWidget.description: Bar chip for SimpleX Chat. Left click toggles the app window between the current view and a hidden special workspace (or launches it if closed); right click refreshes the running state. The chip glows green while the app runs in the background.

schema.label: Path to the SimpleX desktop binary (default: ~/simplex)
Hyprland window class of the app (default: chat-simplex-desktop-MainKt)
